+"""Camera-guided controller for the single Meta-World push-v3 episode.
+
+Usage: python gen.py observe | approach | push [distance_m] | move X Y Z
+Coordinates for move are desired mocap coordinates in metres. All sensing is
+RGB/depth, calibration, proprioception, and the public target point.
+"""
+import json
+import math
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from scipy.ndimage import label
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+ROBOT = Robot()
+SPEC = ROBOT.spec()
+CAMS = ("front", "left", "right", "topview")
+
+
+def components(mask, min_area=10):
+    labs, n = label(mask)
+    result = []
+    for i in range(1, n + 1):
+        ys, xs = np.where(labs == i)
+        if len(xs) >= min_area:
+            result.append((len(xs), np.array([xs.mean(), ys.mean()])))
+    return sorted(result, key=lambda p: -p[0])
+
+
+def red_object(im, cam):
+    a = im.astype(float)
+    rr, gg, bb = np.moveaxis(a, -1, 0)
+    mask = (rr > 65) & (rr > 1.45 * gg) & (rr > 1.4 * bb)
+    yy, xx = np.indices(mask.shape)
+    if cam == "front":
+        mask &= (yy > 110) & (yy < 175) & (xx > 95) & (xx < 215)
+    elif cam in ("left", "right"):
+        mask &= (yy > 110) & (yy < 175) & (xx > 95) & (xx < 225)
+    return components(mask)[0][1]
+
+
+def green_target(im, cam):
+    a = im.astype(float)
+    rr, gg, bb = np.moveaxis(a, -1, 0)
+    mask = (gg > 65) & (gg > 1.35 * rr) & (gg > 1.15 * bb)
+    yy, xx = np.indices(mask.shape)
+    mask &= (yy > 30) & (yy < 190) & (xx > 40) & (xx < 275)
+    return components(mask)[0][1]
+
+
+def ray_plane(cam, uv, z):
+    c = META["cameras"][cam]
+    mat = np.array(c["cam2world_gl"])
+    f = c["intrinsic_cv"][0][0]
+    # The visible target marker establishes a 7 px principal-point offset.
+    # MuJoCo's camera metadata itself reports cx=160, cy=120.
+    u, v = uv
+    direction = mat[:3, :3] @ np.array([(u - 153.0) / f, -(v - 119.5) / f, -1.0])
+    return mat[:3, 3] + direction * ((z - mat[2, 3]) / direction[2])
+
+
+def observe(tag):
+    global META
+    obs = ROBOT.get_obs(cameras=CAMS, include_depth=True, video="none")
+    META = obs.meta
+    obs.save(str(OUT / tag))
+    uv = {cam: red_object(obs.last[cam], cam) for cam in ("front", "left", "right")}
+    world = {cam: ray_plane(cam, uv[cam], .03) for cam in uv}
+    # The front camera sees the forward surface, the two side views locate y.
+    object_xy = np.array([world["front"][0], (world["left"][1] + world["right"][1]) / 2])
+    target = np.array(META["task"]["target_pos"][:2])
+    proprio = dict(zip(META["proprio"]["layout"], META["proprio"]["now"]))
+    data = {"object_xy": object_xy.tolist(), "target_xy": target.tolist(),
+            "pixel": {k: v.tolist() for k, v in uv.items()},
+            "world": {k: v.tolist() for k, v in world.items()},
+            "tcp": [proprio[k] for k in ("tcp_x", "tcp_y", "tcp_z")],
+            "mocap": [proprio[k] for k in ("mocap_x", "mocap_y", "mocap_z")],
+            "time_left_s": META["time_left_s"]}
+    print(json.dumps(data, indent=2), flush=True)
+    return data
+
+
+def move(goal, grip=1.0, tag="move"):
+    obs = ROBOT.get_obs(cameras=("front",), video="none")
+    p = dict(zip(obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"], obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+    start = np.array([p[k] for k in ("mocap_x", "mocap_y", "mocap_z")])
+    delta = np.array(goal) - start
+    steps = int(math.ceil(max(abs(delta)) / .0075))
+    commands = np.zeros((steps + 8, 4), dtype=np.float64)
+    commands[:steps, :3] = delta / steps / .01
+    commands[:, 3] = grip
+    res = ROBOT.submit("ee_delta", commands, dt=SPEC["control_dt"], cameras=CAMS,
+                       include_depth=True, video="none", note=tag)
+    res.save(str(OUT / tag))
+    print(json.dumps({"tag": tag, "steps": steps + 8, "control_steps": res.meta["control_steps"],
+                      "time_left_s": res.meta["time_left_s"]}), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    cmd = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "observe"
+    if cmd == "observe":
+        observe("obs")
+    elif cmd == "approach":
+        data = observe("before_approach")
+        xy = np.array(data["object_xy"])
+        target = np.array(data["target_xy"])
+        direction = (target - xy) / np.linalg.norm(target - xy)
+        # TCP rests approximately 5 cm below the mocap target.
+        behind = xy - .045 * direction
+        move([behind[0], behind[1], .105], 1, "approach")
+        observe("after_approach")
+    elif cmd == "push":
+        data = observe("before_push")
+        xy = np.array(data["object_xy"])
+        target = np.array(data["target_xy"])
+        direction = (target - xy) / np.linalg.norm(target - xy)
+        distance = float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else .04
+        p = np.array(data["mocap"])
+        move([p[0] + distance * direction[0], p[1] + distance * direction[1], p[2]],
+             1, "push")
+        observe("after_push")
+    elif cmd == "move":
+        move([float(x) for x in sys.argv[2:5]], 1, "manual_move")
+        observe("after_move")
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(cmd)
